newsitem.title: BURUNDI: Mine explosions rock Burundi capital.
newsitem.headline: Mine explosions rock Burundi capital.

text.p: Nine mines exploded in the Burundian capital Bujumbura over the weekend, killing one person and seriously wounding at least two others, western diplomats said on Sunday.
Most of the explosions were of anti-personnel mines and occurred on Saturday night. But one, described as an anti-tank mine, went off on Sunday morning.
Bujumbura has been hit by a series of mine explosions in recent weeks in what appears to be a campaign by opponents of the government of military ruler Pierre Buyoya.

Regional African states refuse to recognise Buyoya, who seized power last July in a coup by the Tutsi-dominated army, and have imposed economic sanctions to force him into peace talks with Hutu rebels.
More than 150,000 people have been killed in massacres and civil war between Hutu rebels and the army since 1993.
